text:
alex: Kicking off three-zone deploy for v2.1.3 — canaries in US, then EU, then APAC. Change window 01:00-04:00 UTC. Need a quick capacity and rollback checklist, want pinning guidance for EU if quota tight.
maria: ETA on warm pools? also what's our canary size per region?
sam: Warm pool counts — US: 48 GPUs (warm), EU: 28, APAC: 12. Canary planned at 5% traffic slice each zone. We have ~20% cushion in US, ~10% in EU, ~5% in APAC assuming baseline.
jia: Can confirm autoscale cooldowns are set to 120s, burst enabled for US/EU. APAC autoscale min replicas currently 2 — might need bump to 4 for slice.
alex: Good call. @sam can you bump APAC min to 4 and verify node warmup before canary flip? Log back when done.
sam: On it. giving deploy-bot a note too.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy queued: v2.1.3 -> canary-US (slice=5%) at 01:10 UTC. Rollout plan: US canary -> 5m metrics -> if OK, ramp EU canary -> 5m -> ramp APAC. Fallback: pin to v2.1.2 if error rate > 1.5% or latency p95 > 1200ms for 3 consecutive minutes.
maria: Thresholds sound right. Add a soft-fail condition: if token-cost regression > 10% abort.
ops-bot: Canary metric monitors created: latency_p95, error_rate, cost_token_delta. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and paging policy.
sam: APAC min replicas bumped to 4, warmup started (logs: `kubectl rollout status deployment/infer-apac --watch`). Warm cache prepop job kicked.
jia: Ran quick capacity probe:```
> regions: {US: 48 gpu, EU: 28 gpu, APAC: 14 gpu}
> expected qps baseline: {US: 2000, EU: 900, APAC: 300}
> canary qps per slice: {US:100, EU:45, APAC:15}
> headroom after canary: {US: 35%, EU: 8%, APAC: 3%}
```
alex: EU headroom borderline. Propose pin EU to v2.1.2 at traffic-slice 10% until we warm additional nodes. Then swap to v2.1.3 after backfill. Thoughts?
maria: Agree. If EU error spike > 0.8% we pin immediately. Also let's enable model-variant fallback to quantized-lite for EU to reduce mem pressure.
sam: I'll open the pin now: `redwoodctl pin --region eu --version v2.1.2 --until 02:30UTC || echo pin-failed`
deploy-bot: Pin acknowledged: EU pinned to v2.1.2 until 02:30 UTC per sam.
ops-bot: Noted: fallback variant `v2.1.3-quant-lite` set as automatic fallback for EU.
jia: Canary US flipped at 01:10. Initial 3 minutes: error_rate 0.12%, p95 420ms, cost delta +2.8%. Metrics stable.
alex: Good green. Proceed to EU canary with the pin in place (so only a small controlled slice to validate infra and metrics).
sam: EU canary started at 01:20 with pinned v2.1.2 baseline + v2.1.3 slice 3% for infra checks.
maria: Watching metrics. If EU p95 exceeds 900ms or error_rate >0.8% for 2 consecutive mins we abort.
jia: EU metrics: p95 ~880ms, error 0.6%, but memory pressure trending +12% on a subset of hosts. ops-bot raising a warn now.
ops-bot: WARNING: eu-hostpool-3 memory pressure 82% -> suggest drain for patching.
sam: Initiating small drain on eu-hostpool-3, shift traffic away from affected nodes. Might see slight blips.
alex: If we see error_rate jump >1.0% escalate and pin EU fully to v2.1.2.
maria: Also put release notes snippet in - we need to call out quantization changes and a known perf kink on long-contexts in EU canary. I'll draft.
deploy-bot: EU canary metrics stabilizing after drain: p95 890ms, error 0.55%, cost delta +3.1%.
jia: US ramping to 20% now per plan, metrics still good. APAC will stay warm and we will schedule APAC canary at 02:00 UTC to give EU an extra warmup window.
sam: APAC warm pool extra nodes up (now 6), warm cache prepop complete.
alex: Ok schedule: US ramp -> EU observe -> hold until 01:50 -> APAC canary 02:00. Rollback playbook: `redwoodctl rollback --region <r> --to <version>` plus cancel roll forwards. In severe cases we invoke org-rollback and global pin.
maria: If we need to rollback EU we should run `redwoodctl pin --region eu --version v2.1.2 --reason "perf spike"` and notify customers in 15m.
sam: Creating watch doc and will post an Ops check-in at each handoff.
ops-bot: Reminder: post-release canary note to #incidents if any rollbacks occur.
alex: Final ask: whoever sees sustained metric divergence hit the big-red `halt-rollout` in the deploy UI and @oncall. We don't want silent degradations.
maria: I'll post a short release note in #product after APAC canary completes. Include rollback thresholds and pinned EU note.
jia: APAC canary scheduled at 02:00 and I'll keep a 15m watch after flip.
sam: All prechecks done. standing by for the US ramp (01:15).
deploy-bot: US ramp to 50% at 01:15 as commanded by alex. Monitoring channels active.
alex: Thanks team — call out if anything weird. I'll be on standby until 03:00 UTC. :)
